title: Three wall-clock-dependent tests stopped four scheduled refreshes
detail: Runs 40028653350, 40037957529, 40048429858 and 40063011446 failed before Hotspawn collection when a fixed 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z test fixture aged beyond the publisher's correct 12-hour freshness guard. The tests now inject a deterministic evaluation time; the production guard is unchanged and its stale-refusal regression still passes. The last-verified republish job kept the prior site available, but currentness remains blocked until a fresh post-fix publisher run succeeds.

title: The executive summary rendered the dated research anchor twice
detail: Both the compact unresolved register and summary() appended no_line_research_block, producing two id=no-line-research elements on the published homepage and making anchor navigation ambiguous. The compact register now leaves that block to summary(), while /unresolved/ retains its own full-register copy. No match, pick, probability or source changed. A pre-build unit regression and a 320/390 px every-row browser test now require unique IDs and one research block per page.
